title: Handle streaming AI response parsing in specGenerator.ts
description: Update specGenerator.ts to robustly collect streamed AI output and extract JSON from it. Handle markdown code fences and log raw output on failure.
acceptanceCriteria: Correctly parses JSON wrapped in markdown code fences (```json ... ```)
On malformed JSON, throws a descriptive error
Raw output is logged to .agent/logs/LOG.md on JSON parse failure for debugging

steps.description: Strip markdown code fences from AI output
steps.details: In parseSpecResponse: const stripped = output.replace(/```json\s*/g, '').replace(/```\s*/g, '').trim(). Then extract the JSON object.

In the catch block: if (agentDir) { await fs.appendFile(path.join(agentDir, 'logs', 'LOG.md'), `
## Feature Generation Error
\`\`\`
${output}
\`\`\`
`); } throw new Error(`Could not parse AI response. See .agent/logs/LOG.md for raw output.`)
Create a test that simulates AI output with JSON wrapped in ```json ... ```. Verify parseSpecResponse correctly extracts and parses the JSON.
